mentions.name: engine.build
mentions.description: This is an externally orchestrated, spec-driven agentic build system: after planning work and writing a spec, users delegate the build to a durable orchestrator that coordinates layers of agents through a build -> verify -> review -> triage -> fix -> verify-fixes loop until the resulting code matches the spec. It is offered as an MCP server or CLI, allows mixing and matching models from any provider for any part of the pipeline, and will be free to use and fully open source (Apache 2.0).
mentions.problem: Micromanaging agents is what causes AI burnout; the builder wants to plan work, walk away, and come back knowing it has been correctly implemented.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's an externally orchestrated (meaning it's not the agent running the loop) spec driven agentic build system.

evidence.value: It's an externally orchestrated (meaning it's not the agent running the loop) spec driven agentic build system.
